doc.title: Dianne Reeves interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, October 13, 2001

title: Artistic freedom at Blue Note
summary: She praises Blue Note for allowing total artistic freedom.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: You have a pretty good relationship with Blue Note?
Yeah. I have to say one thing about Blue Note is they do allow their artists total artistic freedom which is really great.
